name: 非Q版鲸鱼娘
description:
CHARACTER REFERENCE — follow the attached image as the definitive design. It is a three-view turnaround of one character. Keep all details below consistent. When generating, draw a single illustration of one character, not a copy of this character sheet, unless the task asks for a turnaround.

Identity: an anime whale girl (DeepSeek whale-girl mascot, the maid version), gentle and slightly smug. Normal anime proportions, about 6–7 heads tall, not chibi.

Hair: long, voluminous, wavy hair reaching about the hips to the upper thighs, not below the knees. Vertical gradient: deep navy/indigo at the crown, transitioning to bright cornflower/sky blue at the tips. Glossy anime highlights. Side-swept bangs with one strand falling between the eyes. A single large looping ahoge curling up from the top of the head.

Whale features (important):
- A pair of whale fins on the sides of the head at ear level, angled slightly upward and outward. Upper side dark navy, underside white/pale blue with ribbed ridges, like a humpback flipper. They are FINS, not feathered wings and not animal ears.
- A large whale tail emerging from the lower back and sweeping out beside the skirt. Navy upper side, pale underside along the tail, ending in a broad blue fluke.

Headwear: a white frilly maid headdress on a dark headband, with a bright-blue ribbon bow at the side, just above the head fins.

Face: large blue eyes with a lighter blue gradient toward the bottom and white highlights, dark upper lashes, soft pink blush, small closed mouth. Default expression: a gentle, calm smile.

Outfit (navy-and-white maid dress):
- White ruffled blouse under a dark navy bodice. The side view shows the white blouse sitting off the shoulder. Long navy sleeves with white ruffled cuffs and a thin gold trim.
- Dark navy bow at the neck with a blue gem brooch.
- Navy bodice with two vertical rows of small gold buttons and a white ruffled panel at the center of the chest.
- White apron with ruffled lace edges and a small blue cartoon whale printed on the lower front.
- Dark navy overskirt, open at the front, over a lighter blue underskirt. Gold vine embroidery and small gold bows along the front hem.
- A large white bow at the back of the waist. Gold vine embroidery continues along the back hem. No shell ornament.
- White ruffled petticoat peeking under the hem.
- White knee-high socks, not frilly ankle socks.
- Dark navy Mary Jane shoes with a strap and a low heel.

Color palette: navy/indigo, cornflower blue, lighter blue underskirt, sky blue hair tips, white, small gold accents. No other dominant colors.

Art style: clean modern anime illustration, normal body proportions, crisp dark-navy line art (not black), soft cel shading, glossy hair highlights, bright and clean colors, high detail on lace and embroidery.

Do NOT: turn the head fins into wings, ears, or horns; omit the ahoge; make the hair a single flat color or grow it below the knees; attach the tail at the front or remove it; change the whale on the apron into another animal; replace the large white back-waist bow; change the outfit colors to black or red; render her chibi or super-deformed; draw a character sheet, turnaround, or multiple copies of her unless the task asks for one.
